`domain:devx` / `priority:p3`, queued. Two recognisers with a byte-identical keyword set and a deliberately different position rule (a masker fails safe by over-masking; a scanner must never skip a span it invented). Drift is guarded by PR #15486's cross-fixture self-test case; the card is about whether the shared half (`REGEX_AFTER_KEYWORD`, the class/escape/flag walk) should live once in `js-comment-mask.mjs` with the position rule as the one parameter. Serial on `check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary.mjs` behind #15486 and on `js-comment-mask.mjs` (check `check-comment-mask-corpus` / `-adoption` before dispatch). Dispatch after #15486 lands.
